title: Shell confirmation bypass through an attacker-controlled executable named cat
source: agent source review + real confirmation dispatcher probe
applicability: Requires a model/tool call invoking an attacker-controlled executable whose basename is allowlisted. A file named cat in a repository is sufficient; no user approval occurred in the probe. This does not prove a language model will choose that path without an attacker influence channel.
flow: model shell arguments -> CoreCodingBackend._resolve_shell_confirmation -> ShellRuntime.is_low_risk_command(Path(argv[0]).name) -> requires_confirmation=False -> execute_confirmable_tool_call -> process execution
observation: Ordinary redirection requested confirmation and was denied. Workspace executable cat wrote a marker with confirmationRequests=0, denied=false.
resolution: Unfixed. Require confirmation for arbitrary/relative executable paths; resolve and validate the executable identity and arguments before any read-only exemption. Also audit option-driven execution and external helpers.

title: Grep follows a file symlink outside the workspace; glob also admits parent traversal
source: agent source review + sandboxed toolkit and confirmation dispatcher probes
assessedSeverity: HIGH for content disclosure; LOW for glob path disclosure alone
applicability: An attacker-controlled workspace contains a symlink to a file readable by the host account outside the selected roots. The normal read tool rejects this same link. grep returns the target content without confirmation. Glob ../outside/* additionally enumerates outside filenames; it does not by itself prove outside content read.
flow: grep(workspace) -> _iter_candidate_files -> unresolved file symlink -> _read_text_file -> model-visible matches; glob pattern -> Path.glob -> resolve with no root revalidation
observation: Synthetic outside canary returned by grep; direct read of outside path and symlink rejected. Parent glob returned outside path.
resolution: Unfixed. Revalidate every enumerated resolved target against workspace roots; reject parent traversal patterns. Use race-resistant file opening for boundaries that must withstand concurrent symlink replacement.

title: Plan discovery reads symlinked plan JSON outside the workspace
source: agent source review + real confirmation dispatcher probe
applicability: Requires an attacker-controlled plans directory or .json symlink and a readable valid plan-shaped JSON outside the selected workspace. Disclosure proved for title, plan id, status and revision; arbitrary non-JSON file disclosure was not proved.
flow: plan_list -> _load_plans -> glob/read_text follows symlink without containment validation -> _PlanState.from_raw -> model-visible title
observation: Both a file symlink and a plans-directory symlink returned a synthetic outside plan title. Write containment controls kept the outside JSON unchanged.
resolution: Unfixed. Apply workspace containment and regular-file checks to discovery/reads, including directory and file symlinks; retain the existing write-side guard.
